name: Integrations hero card with logos and split intro
purpose: Open the integrations directory with the H1 and demo CTA, show customer logos, then introduce the directory below with a split H2.
description: Green legacy styling (/lms/integrations): a hairline-bordered 2-column card (copy: eyebrow tag, serif 3.8rem/1.1 H1, 18px paragraph, green pill button + 3 overlapping avatars and a users line | full-height visual, 3:2 <=991), one column <=767. Below: a centred logo lead line + 6 logos, then a split header (heading-h2 left, grey paragraph right; stacked <=991).
